title: Designer Maroquinerie Junior (Junior Leather Goods Designer)
note: Junior role in the leather goods studio focused on accessories like belts, straps and key rings; posting is in French and asks for design-school graduates.

facts.summary: Junior designer in Longchamp's Paris leather goods studio, working alongside senior designers on accessories and special projects.
facts.duties: Design belts, shoulder straps and key rings; create colour/material variations of existing bags; sketch, render and make technical and full-scale drawings; follow prototypes with the development team through production.
facts.requirements: Graduate of a fashion, design or applied arts school (accessories/leather goods focus a plus); Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign; hand and iPad drawing; knowledge of leather materials and construction; 3D (Rhino, KeyShot, CLO) and professional English are pluses.
facts.apply: Apply online through Longchamp's Workday careers posting.
